name: Western Cape Department of Economic Development and Tourism (DEDAT)
description: DEDAT leads the Western Cape Government’s work to grow the provincial economy and create jobs. Its mission is to drive economic growth for jobs, enabling businesses to thrive in the Western Cape. Its work is guided by the province’s Growth for Jobs strategy, which sets the goal of a R1 trillion inclusive economy and 5 per cent GDP growth by 2035, built on partnerships and co-operation across government, the private sector and civil society. DEDAT supports Co.lab and Origin Stories through CaiPE, the Cape Applied AI Programme and Ecosystem.
